title: RPG maker MV crashing whenever i click import in the resource manager

posts.author: slungus_7
posts.body:
so i got rpg maker MV from the rpg maker beyond expectations bundle on humblebundle and i created a project but a bit after whenever i click import in the resource manager the first time it works and im able to import something but the second it just freezes and i have to manually close rpg maker mv through task manager I'm using version 1.6.3 and windows 11 on a rog ally z1 extreme i have no idea why this is happening
I've tried:
excluding the rpg maker mv folder on steam from windows defender
restarting my computer

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
can you give us the full filepath of where you placed the project? From drive letter to index.html
if you make a new project, does the same happen to that project or does the import work there?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
slungus_7 said:
stupid test game
Click to expand...
That for example would be an illegal foldername because in HTML adresses, spaces are forbidden.
And I hope that your account name contains only regular letters without spaces as well for the same reason.
slungus_7 said:
edit: just created a new project and it stopped freezing
Click to expand...
That basically means that you added a file to your project that causes those problems, and now should start with a copy of the project and test which file causes the problems.
The reason can either be that the file is damaged (for example by a wrong synch with onedrive) or because it is of a type that conflicts with what the editor expects.
